with claude on the PATH, setup runs:
  claude mcp add --scope user maku -- maku mcp

otherwise: add this to ~/.claude.json (maku setup never edits a config):

{
  "mcpServers": {
    "maku": {
      "command": "maku",
      "args": ["mcp"]
    }
  }
}

setup installs the maku-handoff skill in ~/.claude/skills
and the /maku command (handoff, task, inbox) in ~/.claude/commands
